title: Data Collection
content: ClickHouse seamlessly integrates with OpenTelemetry, the growing industry standard for building observability solutions. OpenTelemetry is a first-class citizen in the ClickHouse ecosystem with continued contributions to components like the ClickHouse collector and exporter.

title: ClickHouse
content:
**Ingestion**
ClickHouse is designed to handle large continuous streams of ingest data, supporting ingestion rates of gigabytes per second.

[Materialized Views](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/guides/developer/cascading-materialized-views) can be leveraged to transform data at insert time, supporting common tasks such as extracting structure from unstructured logs as they're inserted.

**Resource Efficiency**
ClickHouse is purpose-built to deliver the most efficient utilization of resources, which results in significant cost savings. Developers report up to 10-100x in reduction of cost when switching to ClickHouse for their observability store.

Unlike other JVM-based solutions, ClickHouse can exploit the full resources of a machine and scale both horizontally and vertically to systems with hundreds of cores and PBs of memory.

**Compression & Tiered Storage**
ClickHouse's column-oriented design delivers best-in-class compression ratios, reducing storage burden and further accelerating query performance.

[Flexible storage policies](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/integrations/s3) and [MergeTree table engines](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/engines/table-engines/mergetree-family/mergetree#table_engine-mergetree-multiple-volumes) allow data to reside on local disks for defined periods before migrating to object storage, creating “hot” and “cold” tiers to balance query performance and storage efficiency.

**Real-time Analysis**
ClickHouse supports a wide range of powerful aggregation and analytical functions that make real-time data exploration simple.

Primary indices allow fast filtering on key metadata, combined with linear scans which use the entire resources of a machine for cost-efficient and fast searches.

Secondary inverted indexes can optionally be applied to selective columns to further accelerate queries for time-critical workloads to ensure blazingly-fast data analysis and to power critical customer-facing dashboards.

title: UI, Alerting & Reports
content:
ClickHouse benefits from a vibrant ecosystem of integrations that includes visualization tools like Grafana and Superset.

The [ClickHouse-Grafana](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/integrations/grafana) integration is a popular choice among observability practitioners who benefit from its powerful dashboarding capabilities that allow for easy ad-hoc exploration of the underlying data, as well as great utility features including alerting.
